column1: # Manual log of where papers and books are applied (design note: keep a parallel log of which research papers and books were applied and where; it eases writing documentation and back-citations).
# This file holds what the repo text does not show as a reference: a work mentioned only by title or by author and year, a method without a reference, reading that influenced a decision.

# References in the text (ACL ids, paths papers/… and books/…, aliases from tools/papers/aliases.tsv, "author and year" with a work in the library) are collected by `tools/papers usage` itself; they do not belong here.
#   work — ACL id (checked against the ACL bibliography), library folder (papers/…, books/… or a bare folder name) or "outside the library: author year title";
#   where — repo file, optionally #section (start of the heading);
#   how — rule source | knowledge source | bar or metric | method | data | format | precedent | review | mention;
#   who — Mova or small model (with a qualifier);
# A bad row (unknown id, folder, file or section; date, "how", "who") stops `papers usage` before the outputs are written.
